steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Like Mania, the black goo is the materialization of spiritual contamination. But unlike Corruptors, they cannot be completely eliminated.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The black goo monsters are from the vomit of those two Sleepwalkers! To stop the goo, we have to deal with them first! Detective Hella is gonna take care of them now!

After two clean-cut blows to the head, the two Sleepwalkers fall to the ground, their mouths stuffed with garbage bags by Hella. They are in a half-conscious stupor, but at least they've finally stopped spewing black goo.
Yet the other muddle-headed guy is still wandering about vigorously.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Look at me! Who says I've gotten rusty? I'm in great shape! I took care of those Sleepwalkers! I'm... the incredible... inspector!
He zigzags before you, spins the beat-up shoe in his hand, and stuffs it into his back pocket.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk tsk... Cops are embarrassing the whole world over.
He spins around, takes out the shoe from his pocket and points it at you.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Hiding behind a little girl, how useless... But you didn't run away... So at least... you have a bit of guts.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Keep up. I'll teach you how to crack a case—Ughhh!
The sluggish, hot-tempered man spins around and trips over the garbage bags. You rush over and try your best to keep him from falling.
You don't notice at all that someone has been watching you and your companions from the club's terrace.
